ordo-virtutum-hildegard.description: A veiled woman in a black habit and white wimple, with a cross on her chest, stands in a dim stone chapel with arched bays and a fresco. She raises one hand toward a row of nuns holding a book and singing under candlelight. A horned, clawed devil crouches in the shadows at the right edge.

machaut-messe-de-nostre-dame.description: Five men in dark robes, some with fur collars and some in monk-like hoods, sing around a large open book of music on a dark wooden lectern. Two tall lit candles stand on brass holders beside the book, and a third candle is behind it. The setting is a stone interior with pointed Gothic arches, ribbed vaulting and tall columns fading into shadow. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or frame.

dufay-nuper-rosarum-flores.description: A large brick-red domed cathedral with white and green marble facing, seen from an elevated angle over a city of terracotta rooftops and distant hills. In the square below, a procession of clergy in gold, white and red vestments moves toward the central doorway through a crowd of people in long dark and muted period robes. Red petals drift through the air. No visible text, frame or border.

palestrina-pope-marcellus-mass.description: A painted stone interior with rounded arches and wall frescoes. A choir of boys and men in white surplices sings from a marble balustrade gallery, and one man holds up a large open book. In the lower right foreground an elderly man in a red cardinal's cape and red skullcap sits on a wooden bench, chin in hand, listening, with more red-robed clerics seated behind him. Candles burn on wall sconces and light comes through high windows.

bach-brandenburg-concertos.description: A candlelit panelled room with a man in a powdered wig and embroidered dark coat playing a large ornate harpsichord with a painted lid. Behind him, a violinist, a cellist and another violinist play. Framed portraits hang on the wooden walls, and a curtain is at the upper left. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

haydn-creation-oratorio.description: An elderly man with white hair and a black ribbon queue, in a dark coat with white cuffs, raises one arm and holds a rolled sheet of paper aloft. He faces a large candlelit hall with gilt ceiling paintings and crystal chandeliers, where an orchestra of strings, horns and a harpsichord plays and a chorus of men and women in 18th-century dress sings from music stands. A shaft of light falls through a high window onto the scene.

berlioz-symphonie-fantastique.description: A dark-haired young man in a white shirt and dark waistcoat lies slumped and asleep in a red velvet armchair beside a table with a lit candle, a small bottle of red liquid and scattered papers. Above him a pale ghostly woman in a long white gown drifts through swirling smoke, and behind her dark horned and winged figures and dancing wraiths fill a shadowy, painterly background. Oil-painting style, edge to edge, no visible text or frame.

mendelssohn-wedding-march.description: A dim forest scene with tall trees and misty light. Winged fairies in pale gauzy dresses and flower crowns stand around a bride in a white veil and gown and a groom in a dark tailcoat. Below, in the foreground, a conductor with a baton faces a seated orchestra with violins, a tuba and candlelit music stands, and lanterns glow in the fog.

strauss-blue-danube-waltz.description: A grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers and gilt-trimmed arches. A couple in a navy and cream lace gown and a black tailcoat waltzes in the foreground, with other dancing couples behind them. On the right a violinist in tails conducts a seated orchestra from a raised platform lit by candles, and balcony spectators look on. Mid-19th-century dress and furnishings, painted in a loose oil style.
